en_title: Dispatch Gets Over 16 Hours of New Content With Commentary Track, Mobile Version, and Live Concert to Celebrate Its First Anniversary
cn_title: 《超英派遣中心》一周年内容大更新
subtitle: 从屏幕走进现实
opus_summary: 《超英派遣中心》迎来发售一周年，AdHoc Studio推出评论音轨、分镜模式和移动版，并公布周边商品及现场音乐会。移动版将于12月9日登陆安卓和iOS，玩家可免费游玩前四集。

paragraphs.en: Dispatch is now officially one year old! To celebrate, AdHoc Studio is giving fans oodles of new content in the form of a commentary track and storyboard modes, a new mobile version of the game, a live concert with a performance from Prism herself, and yes, more merch.
paragraphs.cn: 《超英派遣中心》正式迎来发售一周年！为庆祝这一时刻，AdHoc Studio为玩家准备了大量新内容：评论音轨、分镜模式、游戏手机版、由Prism本人参与演出的现场音乐会，当然还有更多周边商品。

paragraphs.en: AdHoc’s debut title, Dispatch , released to rave reviews on October 22, 2025. Made up of Telltale alumni, the devs truly flexed their storytelling chops with this game, bringing players along for Robert’s journey from zero to hero alongside a chaotic cast of lovable, super-powered characters.
paragraphs.cn: AdHoc的首款作品《超英派遣中心》于2025年10月22日发售，并收获好评。这支由Telltale老成员组成的开发团队充分展现了讲故事的功力，带玩家跟随Robert踏上从无名小卒成长为英雄的旅程，同时结识一群混乱又讨人喜欢的超能力角色。

paragraphs.en: A year later, fans are anxiously awaiting more updates on AdHoc’s next project — but in the meantime, they can whet their appetites on some exciting additions to Dispatch and fun experiences that bring the game's digital world to reality.
paragraphs.cn: 一年过去，玩家仍在焦急等待AdHoc下一款作品的更多消息。在此期间，他们可以体验《超英派遣中心》的新内容，以及将游戏数字世界带入现实的各种活动。

paragraphs.en: Now included in Dispatch's Deluxe Edition are a Commentary Mode and Storyboard Mode. Commentary Mode brings players back to the days of DVD Special Features with two separate audio tracks, where the game’s actors and developers chat about the project in the background as the game progresses. Each choice will give you new insights into the game, so there’s even more replayability for curious fans who want all the gritty details about how Dispatch was made. Storyboard mode shows players the sketches that laid out how the game's scenes were planned, and it can even be paired with Commentary Mode for a double-whammy.
paragraphs.cn: 《超英派遣中心》豪华版现已加入评论模式和分镜模式。评论模式仿照DVD特别收录内容，提供两条独立音轨。玩家游玩时，可以在背景中听到游戏演员和开发者聊起项目。不同选择会带来新的游戏见解，让好奇的玩家有更多理由重玩，了解《超英派遣中心》的制作细节。分镜模式则会展示游戏场景规划时绘制的草图，也可以与评论模式同时开启，获得双重体验。

paragraphs.en: The Deluxe Edition also comes with a digital art book and four digital comics. What’s more, those who already own the Deluxe Edition will get the Commentary and Storyboard modes for free, while those who have the standard version of the game can upgrade for $10.99 USD.
paragraphs.cn: 豪华版还包含一本数字美术设定集和四部数字漫画。已经拥有豪华版的玩家可以免费获得评论模式和分镜模式；标准版玩家则可支付10.99美元(约合人民币73元)升级。

paragraphs.en: But wait, there’s more! Dispatch is also coming to mobile, letting you join Rob on his adventures wherever you’re at in the world. The game releases on Android and iOS on December 9, 2026, with additional support for Google Play Games on PC. The base game has been rebuilt for touch screens and vertical play, and mobile players can get the first four episodes for free. The full release will cost $19.99, with pre-orders opening on the Google Play store and Apple store soon.
paragraphs.cn: 还不止这些！《超英派遣中心》也将推出手机版，让玩家无论身处何地，都能加入Rob的冒险。游戏将于2026年12月9日登陆安卓和iOS，并支持PC端Google Play Games。开发团队针对触屏和竖屏游玩重新制作了基础游戏内容，手机版玩家可以免费体验前四集。完整版售价为19.99美元(约合人民币134元)，Google Play和Apple Store即将开放预购。

paragraphs.en: Fans have been begging for more merchandise in the months since Dispatch first came to Steam, and now, they finally get their wish. A three-record soundtrack vinyl set, featuring artwork from Dispatch’s art director, Derek Stratton, will be available to purchase, and 100 of those will be signed by him. Shirts, hoodies, and four physical comics are also available for purchase, with each volume boasting an individual cover that creates an epic battle scene when placed side by side. A Dispatch: Design Works hardcover book and collectible box are also up for sale, going behind the scenes with concept art, cast interviews, developer insights, and more. And for the real collectors out there, the first 1,000 orders placed on the official online store will get a never-before-seen limited edition, numbered collector’s card.
paragraphs.cn: 自《超英派遣中心》登陆Steam以来，玩家几个月来一直在呼吁推出更多周边，如今愿望终于实现。三碟装原声黑胶唱片即将发售，唱片封面由《超英派遣中心》艺术总监Derek Stratton设计，其中100套将由他亲笔签名。玩家还可以购买T恤、连帽衫和四本实体漫画；漫画每册都有独立封面，摆在一起便会组成一幅宏大的战斗场景。《超英派遣中心：设计作品集》精装书和收藏盒也已开售，内容包括概念艺术、演员访谈、开发者见解等幕后资料。对于收藏爱好者，官方网店最先下单的1,000名顾客还将获得一张此前从未公开、带编号的限量收藏卡。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps most excitingly, the music of Dispatch is getting brought to life with a special concert for one night only. On Thursday, December 3, fans can gather at the AVALON Hollywood to watch ‘Hoes Depressed’ singer and the voice of Prism, THOT SQUAD, perform songs from the game live alongside Bershy, Primer, Caroline Kingsbury, and Fartbarf. Tickets for this event are extremely limited, with AdHoc Studio email subscribers getting first pick before they open up to the general public. It's an in-person event only, so it won't be streamed, and you'll want to get your tickets fast.
paragraphs.cn: 最令人期待的或许是，《超英派遣中心》的音乐将通过一场仅此一晚的特别音乐会呈现在现场。12月3日星期四，玩家可以前往AVALON Hollywood，欣赏《Hoes Depressed》演唱者、Prism配音演员THOT SQUAD，与Bershy、Primer、Caroline Kingsbury和Fartbarf共同现场演奏游戏曲目。门票数量非常有限，AdHoc Studio邮件订阅者可以优先购票，之后才会向公众开放。音乐会仅限现场参与，不会线上直播，想去的观众需要尽快购票。

paragraphs.en: "Dispatch was only possible because of folks who believed in it enough to show up and do their best work. In our industry, it's often really hard to showcase those people and how the development process actually works, but fortunately our game is very weird and specific and affords us some unique opportunities." said Nick Herman, Co-Creative Director on Dispatch and COO of AdHoc Studio.
paragraphs.cn: 《超英派遣中心》之所以能够问世，离不开那些相信这个项目、愿意到场并全力以赴的人。在我们的行业里，展示这些人以及游戏实际开发过程往往非常困难；但幸运的是，我们的游戏风格独特、主题鲜明，因此有机会以特别的方式呈现这些内容。」《超英派遣中心》联合创意总监、AdHoc Studio首席运营官Nick Herman说道。

paragraphs.en: "So for the fans who made Dispatch a part of their lives, we wanted to give them more ways to experience the world they love, whether that’s playing alongside the cast and crew, experiencing the entire game in its original storyboards, or hanging out together IRL at the wildest version of a Dispatch concert our finance team would sign off on."
paragraphs.cn: 「所以，对于那些让《超英派遣中心》成为生活一部分的玩家，我们希望提供更多方式，让他们体验自己喜爱的游戏世界：无论是和演员及开发团队一同游玩、通过原始分镜完整体验游戏，还是在线下聚会，参加一场连财务团队都会批准的最狂野的《超英派遣中心》音乐会。」

paragraphs.en: If you haven't gotten to play Dispatch yet, now is the time. IGN scored the game a glowing 9 out of 10 , with reviewer Sara Thwaites calling it a "sharp-witted workplace comedy that charms with its smart dialogue choices, great writing, and lovably aggravating cast."
paragraphs.cn: 如果你还没玩过《超英派遣中心》，现在正是时候。IGN为游戏打出9分（满分10分）的高分，评测者Sara Thwaites称它是「一部机智风趣的职场喜剧，以巧妙的对话选择、出色的文笔和一群惹人喜爱又令人抓狂的角色打动玩家」。
